responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s fine-grained location model within and across functions. It defines function_point and program_point behavior for representing before-supernode, before-statement, and after-supernode positions together with call-string context; printing, hashing, ordering, and successor navigation; and inlining-aware intraprocedural equivalence checks used by graph exploration, merging, and diagnostic path reasoning.
same_name_distinction: Implements the behavior of function_point and program_point declared in program-point.h, including printing, hashing, ordering, next-point navigation, and intraprocedural-equivalence logic over supergraph locations plus call-string context.
